description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithMembershipId' that implements 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides functionality to fetch and return the name of a membership based on a provided membership ID, using a 'MembershipService'.

classes.name: FormatWithMembershipId
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting a membership ID into its corresponding membership name, utilizing the MembershipService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the membership name corresponding to the provided membership ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembershipService.
